_comment: Item definitions (LT-11: data, not code). Blocks (blocks.json) and objects (objects.json) also register items with their own id. category: material | tool | consumable | schematic. stack defaults: material 999, everything else 1. icon = [col,row] in assets/sprites/items.png.

items.desc: Salvaged lumber — burns, builds, and braces.
items.name: Wood

items.desc: Salvage metal — the city's most versatile material.
items.name: Scrap Metal

items.desc: Molded scrap — light parts and cheap fittings.
items.name: Plastic

items.desc: Torn fabric — bandages, beds, and gear.
items.name: Cloth

items.desc: Concrete rubble — heavy, solid construction.
items.name: Stone

items.desc: Refined metal for serious tools.
items.name: Iron Ingot

items.desc: Opens stuck doors and scraps furniture faster; a serviceable early weapon.
items.name: Pry Bar

items.desc: A quick, light blade — the least slowed weapon underwater.
items.name: Scrap Knife

items.desc: Builds and breaks: places structures, knocks out blocks and back walls.
items.name: Hammer

items.desc: A proper blade: faster and harder-hitting than scrap.
items.name: Iron Knife

items.desc: Stops bleeding and restores a little health.
items.name: Bandage

items.desc: Preserved food — restores hunger anywhere.
items.name: Canned Food

items.desc: Chemical light. Sinks when dropped — mark flooded rooms and routes.
items.name: Glowstick

items.desc: Forged from iron - the hard-suit and rebreather metal.
items.name: Steel

items.desc: Tier-2 pry tool - shears the chained metal doors.
items.name: Bolt Cutters

items.desc: Tier-3 - burns through vault doors and anything chained.
items.name: Cutting Torch

items.desc: Keeps The Cold out; The Dark still bites.
items.name: Wetsuit

items.desc: Armored dive shell - survives The Dark and The Crush, swims like a brick.
items.name: Hard Suit

items.desc: Hands-free light wherever you look.
items.name: Helmet Lamp

items.desc: +30s of air. Crude, welded, works.
items.name: Scrap Air Tank

items.desc: +60s of air in a proper pressure vessel.
items.name: Iron Air Tank

items.desc: Recycles your breath - minutes underwater.
items.name: Steel Rebreather

items.desc: Found gear: +20% swim speed.
items.name: Diver Fins

items.desc: Found gear: scrap 25% faster.
items.name: Tool Belt

items.desc: Found gear: carry 40 more weight before it slows your swim.
items.name: Weight Belt

items.desc: Found gear: maps a much wider area as you move.
items.name: Sonar Compass

items.desc: Found gear: a soft chemical glow around you.
items.name: Glow Band

items.desc: Found gear: pace your breath - +10s of air.
items.name: Dive Watch

items.desc: Opens one of the vault doors below.
items.name: Vault Key

items.desc: Teaches the steel rebreather at the Dive Station.
items.name: Rebreather Schematic

items.desc: Teaches the hard suit at the Dive Station.
items.name: Hard Suit Schematic

items.desc: Found only. Quick and loud - and dead weight underwater.
items.name: 9mm Pistol

items.desc: Found only. A semi-auto scrounger's dream; useless submerged.
items.name: Compact SMG

items.desc: Found only. One heavy answer per trigger pull; useless submerged.
items.name: Bolt-Action Rifle

items.desc: A sharpened slab of scrap. Swings slow underwater.
items.name: Scrap Sword

items.desc: A proper forged blade. Swings slow underwater.
items.name: Iron Sword

items.desc: Slow, heavy, and sends things flying. Worst weapon underwater; a fine tree-feller.
items.name: Fire Axe

items.desc: The underwater ranged weapon. Silent; bolts can be picked back up.
items.name: Spear Gun

items.desc: Ammunition for the speargun. Retrievable after the shot.
items.name: Speargun Bolt

items.desc: Ammunition for pistols and SMGs.
items.name: Pistol Rounds

items.desc: Heavy ammunition for rifles.
items.name: Rifle Rounds

items.desc: Stops bleeding and restores a lot of health.
items.name: Medkit

items.desc: Fresh from the flood. Restores a little health.
items.name: Fish Meat

items.desc: Mostly wood, a little scrap. Fells rooftop trees - the bigger, the longer.
items.name: Wooden Axe
Tree Seed
items.desc: Plant it in a planter. Under open sky it grows into a tree to fell for wood.

items.name: Wooden Bucket
items.desc: Empty. Use it on water to fill it, then pour it out to move water by hand.

items.name: Bucket of Water
items.desc: Full of water. Pour it into an open cell to flood, or a planter.

items.name: Wooden Tripod
items.desc: A lashed wood A-frame hoist. Brace it over the roof vent hatch to lever it out - the metal-free way down - and it pops other tier-1 seals (side vents, jammed doors).

items.name: Shotgun Shells
items.desc: 12-gauge buck. Six pellets a shell.

items.name: Arrows
items.desc: Field arrows. Fly true, fall slow, come back.

items.name: Crossbow Bolts
items.desc: Short heavy bolts. Retrievable.

items.name: Nails
items.desc: Framing nails. Gone once fired.

items.name: Rivets
items.desc: Hot rivets. Gone once fired.

items.name: Flares
items.desc: Burning flares. Light where they land.

items.name: Harpoon Bolt
items.desc: Barbed harpoon. Heavy, retrievable.

items.name: Baseball Bat
items.desc: Ash and tape. Swings quick, hits fair.

items.name: Baton
items.desc: Issue nightstick. Fast, light, forgettable.

items.name: Crowbar
items.desc: Pries chained doors and skulls alike.

items.name: Desk Leg
items.desc: Unscrewed in a hurry. Better than nothing.

items.name: Fire Extinguisher
items.desc: Slow, heavy, and it rings when it lands.

items.name: Fireplace Poker
items.desc: Wrought iron with a hook. Reaches.

items.name: Halligan Tool
items.desc: Fire-crew entry bar: fork, adze and pick.

items.name: Hatchet
items.desc: One-hand axe. Fells saplings, opens zombies.

items.name: Kitchen Knife
items.desc: A cook's blade. Quick, and fine underwater.

items.name: Letter Opener
items.desc: Brass and pointless - until it isn't.

items.name: Machete
items.desc: Hardware-aisle steel. Wide, fast cuts.

items.name: Nail Puller
items.desc: Cat's paw. Levers boards and doors.

items.name: Paper Cutter
items.desc: The guillotine arm off an office cutter. Slow, mean.

items.name: Pipe Wrench
items.desc: Two kilos of cast iron on a handle.

items.name: Rebar Club
items.desc: Bent rebar, taped grip. Sends things flying.

items.name: Rescue Axe
items.desc: Short fire axe with a pick. Balanced.

items.name: Stapler
items.desc: Industrial stapler. Someone's last stand.

items.name: Utility Knife
items.desc: Box cutter. Quick, fine underwater, breaks nothing.

items.name: Boarding Axe
items.desc: Marine axe with a spike. Bites underwater.

items.name: Breaching Tool
items.desc: Security entry bar. Pries and pounds.

items.name: Demolition Hammer
items.desc: Powered breaker. Slow wind-up, brutal landing.

items.name: Security Flashlight
items.desc: Four D-cells of aluminium. Lights the way, too.

items.name: Lump Hammer
items.desc: Short sledge. Cracks stone and bone.

items.name: Cane Machete
items.desc: Long field blade. Wide sweeps.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.desc: Digs, breaks stone, punches through ribs.

items.name: Rescue Saw
items.desc: Powered rescue saw. Chews through anything soft.

items.name: Riot Baton
items.desc: Polycarbonate riot stick. Fast and hard.

items.name: Sledgehammer
items.desc: Ten pounds on a hickory haft.

items.name: Spear
items.desc: Boar spear. Thrusts work underwater.

items.name: Splitting Maul
items.desc: Axe on one side, sledge on the other.

items.name: Breaching Hammer
items.desc: Entry sledge. Doors, walls, heads.

items.name: Dive Knife
items.desc: Titanium dive blade. Made for the water.

items.name: Harpoon
items.desc: Barbed hand harpoon. Thrusts hard underwater.

items.name: Felling Axe
items.desc: Full-size timber axe. Fells anything.

items.name: Pinch Bar
items.desc: Long pry bar. Leverage is damage.

items.name: Broad Hatchet
items.desc: Wide-bit hewing hatchet.

items.name: Hunting Knife
items.desc: Drop-point blade. Quick and deep.

items.name: Industrial Cutter
items.desc: Bench cutter torn off its stand. Spins up, then shreds.

items.name: Breaching Sledge
items.desc: Entry team sledge. Sends things through walls.

items.name: Mattock
items.desc: Pick and adze. Breaks ground, breaks bone.

items.name: Hydraulic Cutter
items.desc: Rescue jaws. Opens vault doors and ribcages.

items.name: Industrial Saw
items.desc: Powered circular saw. Fast, loud, wide.

items.name: Pole Hook
items.desc: Long pike pole. Hooks and pulls at reach.

items.name: Rescue Spreader
items.desc: Hydraulic spreader. Pries anything, hits like a truck.

items.name: Breaching Maul
items.desc: The biggest hammer in the city.

items.name: Shock Baton
items.desc: Executive-floor security stick. Fast, and it bites.

items.name: Whaling Harpoon
items.desc: Iron whaling iron. Thrusts to the hilt underwater.

items.name: Tactical Axe
items.desc: Black-anodised breaching axe.

items.name: .22 Rifle
items.desc: Plinker. Light rounds, quiet, cheap. Found only.

items.name: Compact Pistol
items.desc: Pocket pistol from a desk drawer. Found only.

items.name: Compound Bow
items.desc: Sporting compound. Silent; arrows come back.

items.name: Crossbow
items.desc: Hunting crossbow. Slow to span, hits hard.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.desc: Fires a burning flare that lights where it lands.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.desc: Scoped deer rifle. One heavy answer. Found only.

items.name: Nail Gun
items.desc: Framing nailer with the safety filed off.

items.name: Pellet Gun

items.name: Revolver
items.desc: Six rounds, no jams. Found only.

items.name: Service Pistol
items.desc: Issue sidearm. Reliable. Found only.

items.name: Patrol Shotgun
items.desc: Cruiser gun. Close work. Found only.

items.name: Pump Shotgun
items.desc: Bird gun from a hall closet. Found only.

items.name: Rivet Gun
items.desc: Pneumatic riveter. Hot rivets, fast.

items.name: Harpoon Gun
items.desc: Pneumatic harpoon launcher. Underwater artillery.

items.name: Compound Crossbow
items.desc: Cammed crossbow. Faster, harder.

items.name: Patrol Rifle
items.desc: Trunk rifle. Semi-auto. Found only.

items.name: Riot Shotgun
items.desc: Short riot gun. Wide pattern. Found only.

items.name: Tactical Pistol
items.desc: Rail, light, big magazine. Found only.

items.name: Assault Carbine
items.desc: Police carbine. Fast follow-ups. Found only.

items.name: Framing Nailer
items.desc: Heavy-duty nailer. Longer nails, more of them.

items.name: Hunting Magnum
items.desc: Magnum rifle. Stops anything once. Found only.

items.name: Machine Pistol
items.desc: Full-auto pocket gun. Empties fast. Found only.

items.name: Semi-Auto Rifle
items.desc: Ranch rifle. Quick and accurate. Found only.

items.name: Semi-Auto Shotgun
items.desc: Gas gun. Fast shells. Found only.

items.name: Tactical Carbine
items.desc: Corporate security carbine. Found only.

items.name: Tactical Shotgun
items.desc: Entry shotgun. Tight, hard pattern. Found only.

items.name: Battle Rifle
items.desc: Full-power rifle. Heavy, decisive. Found only.

items.name: Combat Shotgun
items.desc: Auto shotgun. The last word up close. Found only.

items.name: Whaling Gun
items.desc: Deck-mounted harpoon gun, carried anyway.

items.name: Industrial Rivet Gun
items.desc: Shipyard riveter. Hot steel at speed.

items.desc: Site security rifle, glassed and tuned. Found only.

items.name: Military Carbine
items.desc: Executive protection carbine. Found only.
